summary: Department owners can manage Azure access on their own resources without a central administrator.

new.title: Department owners delegate on their resources
new.text: Give a department its Azure scopes, and its owners can create, change and commit the department's Azure permission groups at level 3 and below. This is part of Pro.

new.title: Clear limits for department owners
new.text: Owners cannot touch other departments, level 2 or above, or tier 0, and every refusal is in the audit trail. A department with no Azure scopes gives no Azure rights.
